code_adaptations: Load credentials from this public lab .env/environment without the adjacent private lab dependency.
Use portfolio-prefixed hosted dataset names so pseudonymized data does not overwrite private originals.
Point original-fixture verification at the bundled fixtures directory.
Represent Unicode test data with escape sequences; no non-English instructional text.
Generate reproduction commands using the current lab directory instead of a private absolute path.
data_adaptations: Stable public aliases replace real Drive file IDs and source URLs; private folder IDs and local paths replaced.
Private Langfuse trace/account links removed; raw MCP payloads and signed download URLs excluded.
Frozen evidence bodies, claims, quotes, judge decisions and reasoning are retained verbatim.
Public dataset hashes and per-input hashes recomputed; original private source-report hashes retained for provenance.
Public replay is equivalent input structure with aliased IDs, not a byte-identical replay of private requests.
